satellites.description: Existence and last-change of a person's sign-in credential; hash and salt deliberately excluded.
satellites.split_rationale: Separate source (declared as a hub feed); credential values excluded from analytical use.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_phone_number_type_numbers
satellites.description: Telephone numbers of a person per phone number type, with history.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_address_details
satellites.description: Last-changed timestamp of the party-address relationship; history of relationships retained.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_contact_details
satellites.description: Last-changed timestamp of the contact relationship; history retained.

satellites.name: sat_address_details
satellites.description: Street, city and postal details of an address with full history.

satellites.name: sat_address_location
satellites.description: Geographic location (latitude/longitude) of an address.
satellites.split_rationale: Spatial data type and personal-data classification (geographic coordinates).

satellites.name: sat_address_type_details
satellites.description: Address type reference metadata.

satellites.name: sat_contact_type_details
satellites.description: Contact type reference metadata.

satellites.name: sat_phone_number_type_details
satellites.description: Phone number type name, with history of renames.

satellites.name: sat_country_region_details
satellites.description: Country or region name with visible rename history.

satellites.name: sat_state_province_details
satellites.description: State or province ISO code and no-genuine-code flag.

satellites.name: sat_state_province_territory
satellites.description: Sales territory assignment of a state or province, history preserved; territory descriptions come from the sales area.
satellites.split_rationale: Different rate of change and business meaning (territory reassignment) from code/flag details.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_employee_identifiers
satellites.description: Alternate employee identifiers: national ID number and network login. These are used to join data, not to anchor identity.
satellites.split_rationale: Identifier-type attributes; the national ID is sensitive, so these are kept apart from operational job data.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_employee_job
satellites.description: Employment details: job title, hire date, salaried/hourly classification, active status and last-updated timestamp. History is built by observing overwrites.
satellites.split_rationale: Non-sensitive employment attributes that change slowly; this satellite holds the Employee ModifiedDate.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_employee_personal
satellites.description: Restricted personal employee data: date of birth, gender and marital status.
satellites.split_rationale: Data classification: personal data restricted to authorised HR users.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_employee_leave
satellites.description: Point-in-time leave balance readings. Changes are captured as a series of balances.
satellites.split_rationale: Rate of change: leave balances change far more often than other employee attributes.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_employee_hierarchy
satellites.description: The employee's position and depth in the corporate reporting hierarchy. History is built by capturing changes.
satellites.split_rationale: Hierarchy position changes independently of job details and only its current value is held in the source.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_employee_pay
satellites.description: Pay rate history per employee, keyed by effective rate change date: hourly rate and pay frequency.
satellites.split_rationale: Separate source relation at a finer grain (one row per rate change); EmployeePayHistory is declared as a feed of hub_business_entity.

satellites.name: sat_department_details
satellites.description: Department description: owning group and last change date. History is captured because the source overwrites it.

satellites.name: sat_shift_details
satellites.description: Shift definition: start and end time and last-updated timestamp. These can be adjusted over time.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_department_shift_effectivity
satellites.description: Active period of each department/shift assignment. A missing EndDate marks the current assignment.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_department_shift_details
satellites.description: Last-updated timestamp of each assignment record, one row per assignment start date.
satellites.split_rationale: Kept out of the effectivity satellite, which must carry exactly the start and end dates; multi-active on StartDate because repeated stints share the same link key.

satellites.name: sat_job_candidate_resume
satellites.description: The candidate's résumé, held as a structured document, plus a last-updated timestamp.
satellites.split_rationale: Candidate personal data has its own retention and access rules.

satellites.name: sat_product_details
satellites.description: Descriptive and classification attributes of a product.
satellites.split_rationale: Slowly changing descriptive attributes.

satellites.name: sat_product_pricing
satellites.description: Current standard cost and list price on the product record.
satellites.split_rationale: Financial figures change more frequently than descriptive attributes.

satellites.name: sat_product_inventory_policy
satellites.description: Inventory planning parameters.
satellites.split_rationale: Planning parameters maintained by supply chain at their own rate.

satellites.name: sat_product_lifecycle
satellites.description: Sale availability and discontinuation dates, plus record last-modified.
satellites.split_rationale: Lifecycle events change independently.

satellites.name: sat_product_cost_history
satellites.description: Standard cost history periods per product.
satellites.split_rationale: Separate source at finer grain (one row per cost period).

satellites.name: sat_product_list_price_history
satellites.description: List price history periods per product.
satellites.split_rationale: Separate source at finer grain (one row per price period).

satellites.name: sat_product_category_details
satellites.description: Category record currency.

satellites.name: sat_product_subcategory_details
satellites.description: Subcategory record currency.

satellites.name: sat_product_model_catalog
satellites.description: Structured catalogue information for publication.
satellites.split_rationale: Marketing-owned structured content.

satellites.name: sat_product_model_instructions
satellites.description: Structured manufacturing instructions.
satellites.split_rationale: Manufacturing-owned structured content.

satellites.name: sat_culture_details
satellites.description: Culture descriptive name.

satellites.name: sat_unit_measure_details
satellites.description: Unit of measure descriptive name.

satellites.name: sat_product_description_details
satellites.description: Marketing description text.

satellites.name: sat_product_photo_thumbnail
satellites.description: Thumbnail image and file name.
satellites.split_rationale: Thumbnail version separate from large version.

satellites.name: sat_product_photo_large
satellites.description: Large image and file name.
satellites.split_rationale: Large version separate from thumbnail.

satellites.name: sat_product_product_photo_details
satellites.description: Principal-image flag for a product/photo association.

satellites.name: sat_illustration_details
satellites.description: Structured technical diagram.

satellites.name: sat_document_details
satellites.description: Document title, entry type, hierarchy depth, file type and summary.
satellites.split_rationale: Descriptive metadata.

satellites.name: sat_document_revision
satellites.description: Revision, engineering change number and approval status.
satellites.split_rationale: Revision control changes at a different rate.

satellites.name: sat_document_content
satellites.description: Full binary document content; inclusion to be confirmed.
satellites.split_rationale: Large binary data type isolated.

satellites.name: sat_product_assembly_component_effectivity
satellites.description: Active period of a component in an assembly.

satellites.name: sat_product_assembly_component_details
satellites.description: Component quantity per assembly and BOM level, per BOM period start date.
satellites.split_rationale: BillOfMaterials is unique per assembly, component and start date; StartDate distinguishes concurrent rows.

satellites.name: sat_location_details
satellites.description: Hourly cost rate and capacity of a location.

satellites.name: sat_product_location_inventory
satellites.description: Quantity on hand per shelf and bin; captured over time by the vault.

satellites.name: sat_work_order_quantities
satellites.description: Ordered, stocked and scrapped quantities.
satellites.split_rationale: Output quantities separate from schedule.

satellites.name: sat_work_order_schedule
satellites.description: Work order start, end and due dates.
satellites.split_rationale: Schedule dates change independently of quantities.

satellites.name: sat_work_order_operation_schedule
satellites.description: Scheduled and actual operation dates.
satellites.split_rationale: Schedule vs cost concerns; WorkOrderRouting is unique per work order, product and sequence, so ProductID distinguishes rows.

satellites.name: sat_work_order_operation_cost
satellites.description: Resource hours and planned/actual cost of an operation.
satellites.split_rationale: Cost measures separate from schedule; ProductID distinguishes rows at WorkOrderRouting grain.

satellites.name: sat_scrap_reason_details
satellites.description: Scrap reason record currency.

satellites.name: sat_inventory_transaction_details
satellites.description: Live-store transaction details; order reference read with type.
satellites.split_rationale: Live source system.

satellites.name: sat_inventory_transaction_archive_details
satellites.description: Archived transaction details.
satellites.split_rationale: Archive source system.

satellites.name: sat_product_review_details
satellites.description: Review date, rating and comments.
satellites.split_rationale: Non-sensitive review content.

satellites.name: sat_product_review_reviewer_pii
satellites.description: Reviewer identity (personal data).
satellites.split_rationale: PII classification split for data protection.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_vendor_details
satellites.description: Vendor identification and descriptive details: account number, company name, optional purchasing web service address.
satellites.split_rationale: Slow-changing identifying/descriptive vendor attributes, separated from the status codes whose history is analysed.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_vendor_status
satellites.description: Vendor classification codes with history: credit rating, preferred status, active flag.
satellites.split_rationale: Coded status attributes whose change history must be retained and reconstructed at order time; carries the record's ModifiedDate.

satellites.name: sat_purchase_order_status
satellites.description: Purchase order status and revision number, historised to trace status transitions and revisions.
satellites.split_rationale: Fast-changing workflow state, kept apart from dates and financial totals.

satellites.name: sat_purchase_order_dates
satellites.description: Order date and estimated shipment date of the purchase order.
satellites.split_rationale: Scheduling dates, largely static once set.

satellites.name: sat_purchase_order_totals
satellites.description: Order-level financial totals: subtotal, tax, freight and total due.
satellites.split_rationale: Monetary amounts grouped together for spend analysis and reconciliation against lines.

satellites.name: sat_purchase_order_line_terms
satellites.description: Ordered quantity, unit price, line total and due date of the line.
satellites.split_rationale: Order terms set when the line is placed, changing rarely.

satellites.name: sat_purchase_order_line_receipt
satellites.description: Cumulative received, rejected and accepted (stocked) quantities, historised to show receipt progression.
satellites.split_rationale: Running receipt figures that change with deliveries, split from the static order terms; carries ModifiedDate.

satellites.name: sat_product_vendor_terms
satellites.description: Standing commercial supply terms: average lead time, standard price, min/max order quantities.
satellites.split_rationale: Agreed terms changing slowly, historised for trend analysis; separated from running values.

satellites.name: sat_product_vendor_running_values
satellites.description: Running values updated with activity: last receipt cost and date, quantity on order.
satellites.split_rationale: Fast-changing activity-driven figures, split from agreed terms by rate of change; carries ModifiedDate.

satellites.name: sat_ship_method_rates
satellites.description: Ship base and ship rate, historised so historical freight can be assessed against rates in force.
satellites.split_rationale: Changing rate terms; rowguid excluded as it has no business meaning (REQ-077).

satellites.name: sat_ship_method_identifiers
satellites.description: Internal shipping method identifier used on purchase orders.
satellites.split_rationale: Static internal identifier, separated from changing rates.

satellites.name: sat_customer_details
satellites.description: Customer record change tracking for reconciliation with source.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_store_details
satellites.description: Store name.
satellites.split_rationale: Non-sensitive store descriptors separated from confidential demographics.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_store_demographics
satellites.description: Confidential store demographics (employees, annual sales, store type).
satellites.split_rationale: Commercially confidential classification.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_sales_person_compensation
satellites.description: Sales representative current quota, bonus and commission (remuneration data, access-restricted).
satellites.split_rationale: Remuneration data classification; changes on plan revisions.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_sales_person_running_totals
satellites.description: Operationally maintained representative sales running totals.
satellites.split_rationale: High rate of change running totals.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_sales_quota_history
satellites.description: Dated sales quota history per representative.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_sales_territory_history_effectivity
satellites.description: Active period of a representative's territory assignment.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_status
satellites.description: Order status, revision number and sales channel flag.
satellites.split_rationale: Changes as the order progresses.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_dates
satellites.description: Order lifecycle dates.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_totals
satellites.description: Order financial amounts.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_references
satellites.description: Customer PO number, financial account number reference and representative comments.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_payment
satellites.description: Credit card approval code (payment-sensitive).
satellites.split_rationale: Payment-sensitive classification.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_line_pricing
satellites.description: Order line quantity, price, discount and line total.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_line_shipment
satellites.description: Shipper tracking number per line.
satellites.split_rationale: Populated at shipment, different rate of change.

satellites.name: sat_sales_reason_details
satellites.description: Sales reason description and category.

satellites.name: sat_sales_territory_details
satellites.description: Territory geographic group.

satellites.name: sat_sales_territory_financials
satellites.description: Territory sales and cost running totals.
satellites.split_rationale: High rate of change running totals.

satellites.name: sat_credit_card_details
satellites.description: Card type.

satellites.name: sat_credit_card_expiry
satellites.description: Card expiry data (sensitive, access-restricted).
satellites.split_rationale: Sensitive payment data classification.

satellites.name: sat_currency_details
satellites.description: Currency name.

satellites.name: sat_currency_rate_details
satellites.description: Average and end-of-day exchange rates.

satellites.name: sat_special_offer_details
satellites.description: Special offer description, type, category group and quantity thresholds.

satellites.name: sat_special_offer_discount
satellites.description: Special offer discount percentage, tracked over time.
satellites.split_rationale: Commercially significant attribute whose history must be visible.

satellites.name: sat_special_offer_validity
satellites.description: Special offer validity period.

satellites.name: sat_sales_tax_rate_details
satellites.description: Tax rate description, tax type and rate amount.

satellites.name: sat_shopping_cart_item_details
satellites.description: Cart item quantity and creation timestamp.

contracts.name: CountryRegionCurrency
contracts.doc: Mapping of country/region codes to the currency codes used in that country/region (source: Sales.CountryRegionCurrency). The contract enforces the declared schema and business-key uniqueness/not-null; ownership and agreement are to be confirmed at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: CountryRegionCode
schema.description: Code identifying the country or region that uses the currency. Part of the business key.

schema.name: CurrencyCode
schema.description: Code identifying the currency used in the country or region. Part of the business key; relates to Currency.CurrencyCode.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: CreditCard
contracts.doc: Source-to-staging asset for credit card records from the Sales schema. Each record describes a payment card (type, number, expiration month and year) and when it was last modified. The contract enforces the declared schema, primary key and not-null rules; value-level semantics are only flagged where requirements support them. Ownership and agreement status are to be resolved at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: CreditCardID
schema.description: Unique identifier for a credit card record.

schema.name: CardType
schema.description: The type or brand of the credit card.

schema.name: CardNumber
schema.description: The credit card number. This is sensitive payment data and should be reviewed for handling and masking requirements.

schema.name: ExpMonth
schema.description: Expiration month of the credit card.

schema.name: ExpYear
schema.description: Expiration year of the credit card.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified.

contracts.name: Currency
contracts.doc: Reference list of currencies from the source Sales.Currency table, keyed by CurrencyCode. The contract enforces the declared schema and business-key uniqueness/non-nullness (handled by the deterministic core). Ownership and agreement are pending human review.

schema.name: CurrencyCode
schema.description: Business key identifying the currency (currency code, e.g. a three-letter code).

schema.name: Name
schema.description: Descriptive name of the currency.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: CurrencyRate
contracts.doc: Exchange rate between two currencies for a given date, staged from the Sales.CurrencyRate source table. The contract enforces the declared schema and the business key (CurrencyRateID); value-level semantics are advisory pending producer/consumer review.

schema.name: CurrencyRateID
schema.description: Unique identifier for a currency rate record (source surrogate key).

schema.name: CurrencyRateDate
schema.description: Date and time the exchange rate was obtained.

schema.name: FromCurrencyCode
schema.description: Source currency code the exchange rate converts from; refers to Currency.CurrencyCode.

schema.name: ToCurrencyCode
schema.description: Target currency code the exchange rate converts to; refers to Currency.CurrencyCode.

schema.name: AverageRate
schema.description: Average exchange rate for the day.

schema.name: EndOfDayRate
schema.description: Final exchange rate for the day.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: Customer
contracts.doc: Customer records from the Sales source, staged as-is. Each row represents a customer, who may be an individual (PersonID) or a store (StoreID), optionally assigned to a sales territory. The contract enforces the declared schema, business key and not-null rules; value-level semantics are left for producer/consumer negotiation.

schema.name: CustomerID
schema.description: Unique identifier of the customer; business key of the asset.

schema.name: PersonID
schema.description: Identifier of the individual person who is the customer. Reference to a person record; may be absent for store customers.

schema.name: StoreID
schema.description: Identifier of the store that is the customer. Reference to a store record; may be absent for individual customers.

schema.name: TerritoryID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales territory the customer belongs to. Reference to SalesTerritory.

schema.name: AccountNumber
schema.description: Customer account number used to identify the customer in business transactions.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique row identifier (GUID) for the record.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified in the source.

contracts.name: PersonCreditCard
contracts.doc: Association between a person (business entity) and a credit card, sourced from the Sales.PersonCreditCard table and staged as-is. The contract enforces the presence and types of BusinessEntityID, CreditCardID and ModifiedDate; key and not-null checks are handled by the deterministic core. Ownership and agreement are to be confirmed at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: BusinessEntityID
schema.description: Identifier of the business entity (person) that holds the credit card. Reference to the person/business entity record.

schema.name: CreditCardID
schema.description: Identifier of the credit card associated with the person. Reference to the CreditCard record.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the association record was last modified in the source.

contracts.name: SalesOrderDetail
contracts.doc: Line-item detail of a sales order: one row per product line on a sales order, including quantity, pricing, discount and line total. Contract enforces the declared schema and business-key identity; value-level semantics are advisory pending producer/consumer review.

schema.name: SalesOrderID
schema.description: Identifier of the parent sales order (header) this line belongs to.

schema.name: SalesOrderDetailID
schema.description: Identifier of the individual line item within the sales order.

schema.name: CarrierTrackingNumber
schema.description: Shipment tracking number assigned by the carrier for this line item.

schema.name: OrderQty
schema.description: Quantity of the product ordered on this line.

schema.name: ProductID
schema.description: Identifier of the product ordered on this line.

schema.name: SpecialOfferID
schema.description: Identifier of the special offer applied to this line item.

schema.name: UnitPrice
schema.description: Selling price per unit of the product on this line.

schema.name: UnitPriceDiscount
schema.description: Discount applied to the unit price for this line.

schema.name: LineTotal
schema.description: Total amount for the line (quantity, unit price and discount combined).

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique identifier (GUID) for the row.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the row was last modified in the source.

contracts.name: SalesOrderHeader
contracts.doc: Sales order header records from the source system, one row per sales order, carrying order dates, status, customer/sales person/territory references, shipping and billing references, and monetary totals. The contract enforces the declared schema and business key (SalesOrderID). No value-level semantic constraints are asserted because none are stated in the requirements. Ownership and agreement remain to be settled at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: SalesOrderID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales order; business key of the header.

schema.name: RevisionNumber
schema.description: Revision number of the sales order.

schema.name: OrderDate
schema.description: Date the sales order was created.

schema.name: DueDate
schema.description: Date the order is due to the customer.

schema.name: ShipDate
schema.description: Date the order was shipped to the customer.

schema.name: Status
schema.description: Current status code of the order. Allowed values are not specified in the requirements.

schema.name: OnlineOrderFlag
schema.description: Flag indicating whether the order was placed online.

schema.name: SalesOrderNumber
schema.description: Unique human-readable sales order number.

schema.name: PurchaseOrderNumber
schema.description: Customer purchase order number reference.

schema.name: AccountNumber
schema.description: Financial accounting number reference for the customer.

schema.name: CustomerID
schema.description: Reference to the customer who placed the order.

schema.name: SalesPersonID
schema.description: Reference to the sales person who took the order.

schema.name: TerritoryID
schema.description: Reference to the sales territory in which the sale was made.

schema.name: BillToAddressID
schema.description: Reference to the customer billing address.

schema.name: ShipToAddressID
schema.description: Reference to the customer shipping address.

schema.name: ShipMethodID
schema.description: Reference to the shipping method used.

schema.name: CreditCardID
schema.description: Reference to the credit card used for payment.

schema.name: CreditCardApprovalCode
schema.description: Approval code provided by the credit card company.

schema.name: CurrencyRateID
schema.description: Reference to the currency exchange rate applied to the order.

schema.name: SubTotal
schema.description: Order subtotal (sum of line totals) before tax and freight.

schema.name: TaxAmt
schema.description: Tax amount for the order.

schema.name: Freight
schema.description: Shipping cost for the order.

schema.name: TotalDue
schema.description: Total amount due from the customer for the order.

schema.name: Comment
schema.description: Free-text sales representative comments on the order.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique row identifier used by the source system.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source row was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesOrderHeaderSalesReason
contracts.doc: Association between sales orders and the sales reasons recorded for them (a many-to-many link between SalesOrderHeader and SalesReason). The contract enforces the schema and the composite key of SalesOrderID and SalesReasonID. Ownership and agreement status are left for human review.

schema.name: SalesOrderID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales order. References SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID.

schema.name: SalesReasonID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales reason. References SalesReason.SalesReasonID.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified in the source.

contracts.name: SalesPerson
contracts.doc: Sales representatives (salespeople) with their assigned sales territory, quota, bonus, commission percentage and sales totals, staged from the source SalesPerson table. The contract enforces the declared schema, business key and not-null constraints; no value-level thresholds are stated in the requirements.

schema.name: BusinessEntityID
schema.description: Identifier of the business entity (person) that is the salesperson; business key of the asset.

schema.name: TerritoryID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales territory currently assigned to the salesperson, if any.

schema.name: SalesQuota
schema.description: Projected yearly sales quota for the salesperson.

schema.name: Bonus
schema.description: Bonus amount due to the salesperson.

schema.name: CommissionPct
schema.description: Commission percentage received by the salesperson on sales.

schema.name: SalesYTD
schema.description: Sales total of the salesperson year to date.

schema.name: SalesLastYear
schema.description: Sales total of the salesperson in the previous year.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique row identifier (GUID) used for replication/row identification in the source.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source row was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesPersonQuotaHistory
contracts.doc: Historical record of sales quotas assigned to sales persons, one row per sales person and quota date. The contract enforces the declared schema and business-key uniqueness/not-null; value-level semantics are advisory. Ownership and agreement status are to be resolved at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: BusinessEntityID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales person (business entity) to whom the quota was assigned.

schema.name: QuotaDate
schema.description: Date on which the sales quota took effect for the sales person.

schema.name: SalesQuota
schema.description: Sales quota amount assigned to the sales person as of the quota date.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Row-level globally unique identifier (GUID) for the record.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Timestamp of when the record was last modified in the source.

contracts.name: SalesReason
contracts.doc: Lookup of reasons a customer gave for purchasing a sales order (source: Sales.SalesReason), staged from source. The contract enforces the declared schema, the business key (SalesReasonID) and not-null rules; no value-level thresholds are mandated by the requirements.

schema.name: SalesReasonID
schema.description: Unique identifier of the sales reason; business key of the asset.

schema.name: Name
schema.description: Name or description of the sales reason.

schema.name: ReasonType
schema.description: Category of the sales reason.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified in the source.

contracts.name: SalesTaxRate
contracts.doc: Sales tax rates by state/province, staged from the source SalesTaxRate table. The contract enforces the declared schema and key fields; value-level semantics are limited to what the requirements support. Ownership and agreement are pending human review.

schema.name: SalesTaxRateID
schema.description: Unique identifier for a sales tax rate record.

schema.name: StateProvinceID
schema.description: Identifier of the state or province to which the tax rate applies.

schema.name: TaxType
schema.description: Code indicating the type of tax the rate represents. The allowed value set is not specified in the requirements.

schema.name: TaxRate
schema.description: Tax rate applicable for the state or province.

schema.name: Name
schema.description: Name or description of the tax rate.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique identifier (GUID) for the row, used by the source system for replication.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified in the source.

contracts.name: SalesTerritory
contracts.doc: Sales territory reference data from the source system, one record per territory, including its country/region, sales group, and year-to-date and prior-year sales and cost figures. The contract enforces the declared schema, business key (TerritoryID) and not-null rules; value-level semantics are advisory pending producer/consumer review.

schema.name: TerritoryID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales territory (business key).

schema.name: Name
schema.description: Name of the sales territory.

schema.name: CountryRegionCode
schema.description: Code of the country or region the territory belongs to.

schema.name: Group
schema.description: Geographic grouping of the sales territory.

schema.name: SalesYTD
schema.description: Sales in the territory year to date.

schema.name: SalesLastYear
schema.description: Sales in the territory in the previous year.

schema.name: CostYTD
schema.description: Business costs in the territory year to date.

schema.name: CostLastYear
schema.description: Business costs in the territory in the previous year.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Unique row identifier (GUID) used by the source system.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesTerritoryHistory
contracts.doc: Historical record of the sales territories assigned to each salesperson over time, with the start and end dates of each assignment. Staged from the source SalesTerritoryHistory table. The contract enforces the declared schema and business-key constraints. Ownership and agreement status are left for human review.

schema.name: BusinessEntityID
schema.description: Identifier of the salesperson (business entity) assigned to the territory. Refers to the SalesPerson entity.

schema.name: TerritoryID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales territory the salesperson was assigned to. Refers to the SalesTerritory entity.

schema.name: StartDate
schema.description: Date and time when the salesperson's assignment to the territory began.

schema.name: EndDate
schema.description: Date and time when the salesperson's assignment to the territory ended. Empty when the assignment is still current.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique identifier (GUID) for the row.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time when the row was last modified in the source.

contracts.name: ShoppingCartItem
contracts.doc: Items placed in an online shopping cart, as captured in the Sales source. Each row is one product line in a cart. The contract enforces the declared schema, business-key uniqueness and not-null rules; value-level constraints are not stated in the requirements.

schema.name: ShoppingCartItemID
schema.description: Unique identifier for the shopping cart item row.

schema.name: ShoppingCartID
schema.description: Identifier of the shopping cart that the item belongs to.

schema.name: Quantity
schema.description: Quantity of the product in the shopping cart.

schema.name: ProductID
schema.description: Identifier of the product placed in the cart; refers to a product in the product catalog.

schema.name: DateCreated
schema.description: Date and time the item was added to the shopping cart.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the row was last modified in the source.

contracts.name: SpecialOffer
contracts.doc: Sales promotion/discount offers from the source SpecialOffer table, one record per offer, staged from source. The contract enforces the declared schema and the business key (SpecialOfferID); value-level constraints are only alerting unless confirmed by the producer/consumer review.

schema.name: SpecialOfferID
schema.description: Unique identifier of the special offer (business key).

schema.name: Description
schema.description: Description of the discount or special offer.

schema.name: DiscountPct
schema.description: Discount percentage applied by the offer.

schema.name: Type
schema.description: Type of discount offered.

schema.name: Category
schema.description: Group or category the special offer belongs to.

schema.name: StartDate
schema.description: Date and time the offer becomes active.

schema.name: EndDate
schema.description: Date and time the offer ends.

schema.name: MinQty
schema.description: Minimum order quantity required to qualify for the discount.

schema.name: MaxQty
schema.description: Maximum order quantity to which the discount applies. May be absent when no upper limit exists.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Row-unique GUID identifier used by the source system.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: SpecialOfferProduct
contracts.doc: Associative record linking a special offer to a product it applies to (many-to-many between SpecialOffer and Product). The contract enforces the schema and the business keys (SpecialOfferID, ProductID); ownership and agreement are to be confirmed at human review.

schema.name: SpecialOfferID
schema.description: Identifier of the special offer; references SpecialOffer.SpecialOfferID.

schema.name: ProductID
schema.description: Identifier of the product the special offer applies to; references a product in the product catalog.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique row identifier (GUID) for the record.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified.

contracts.name: Store
contracts.doc: Source-to-staging asset representing stores (retail customers) from the Sales schema. The contract enforces the declared field set and schema; primary key and not-null rules are propagated deterministically from the business keys. Ownership and agreement are to be confirmed at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: Name
schema.description: Name of the store.

schema.name: SalesPersonID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales person assigned to the store. Refers to a SalesPerson business entity.

schema.name: Demographics
schema.description: Demographic information about the store. The format and structure are not specified in the requirements and need human review.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique row identifier (GUID) for the record.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified.

name: 'vault_project'
version: '1.0.0'
config-version: 2

profile: 'vault_project'

model-paths: ["models"]
seed-paths: ["seeds"]
analysis-paths: ["analyses"]
test-paths: ["tests"]
macro-paths: ["macros"]

target-path: "target"
clean-targets:

scaffolding.README.md:
# Generated Data Vault project (vault-agent)

A runnable dbt project: `models/staging/` computes the hash keys / hashdiffs via
AutomateDV's `stage` macro, `models/raw_vault/` holds the generated hubs, links, and
satellites. Review `review-queue.md` and `contracts/` before agreeing the model.

## Provide the raw inputs

Each staging model reads one raw relation by name — provide it either as a dbt seed
(`seeds/<name>.csv`, headers exactly as listed) or as a table/view in the target schema:

- `BusinessEntity` → feeds `stg_business_entity_businessentity` (expected columns: BUSINESSENTITYID, MODIFIEDDATE, LOAD_DATETIME, RECORD_SOURCE)
- `Person` → feeds `stg_business_entity_person` (expected columns: BUSINESSENTITYID, PERSONTYPE, NAMESTYLE, TITLE, FIRSTNAME, MIDDLENAME, LASTNAME, SUFFIX, MODIFIEDDATE, EMAILPROMOTION, ADDITIONALCONTACTINFO, DEMOGRAPHICS, LOAD_DATETIME, RECORD_SOURCE)
- `EmailAddress` → feeds `stg_business_entity_emailaddress` (expected columns: BUSINESSENTITYID, EMAILADDRESS, MODIFIEDDATE, EMAILADDRESSID, LOAD_DATETIME, RECORD_SOURCE)
- `Password` → feeds `stg_business_entity_password` (expected columns: BUSINESSENTITYID, MODIFIEDDATE, LOAD_DATETIME, RECORD_SOURCE)

# ADR-0001: Data Vault model derived from requirements

**Status:** Proposed
**Date:** 2026-11-15
**Decision makers:** Vault-Agent (generated) — pending human review

## Context

This model was derived automatically by the Vault-Agent pipeline from 203 requirement(s) and 19 business key candidate(s). It records the Data Vault 2.0 structures the modeler chose and traces each back to the requirements that justify it.

## Decision

Model the following Data Vault 2.0 structures.

### Hubs (11)

- **hub_customer** — business key `AccountNumber`. Customer (individual person or reseller store), identified by the account number assigned by the accounting system. _(requirements: REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-007, REQ-047-3)_
- **hub_sales_order** — business key `SalesOrderNumber`. Sales order, identified by its unique sales order number. _(requirements: REQ-016, REQ-047-3)_
- **hub_sales_order_line** — business key `sales_order_line`. Sales order line, identified within its order by an incremental line number. _(requirements: REQ-044, REQ-045, REQ-047-2)_
- **hub_sales_territory** — business key `Name`. Sales territory from the territory catalogue, keyed on territory name (decided key). _(requirements: REQ-068)_
- **hub_credit_card** — business key `CardNumber`. Credit card used for payment, keyed on card number (decided key); payment-sensitive. _(requirements: REQ-075, REQ-076, REQ-078, REQ-041-3)_
- **hub_currency** — business key `CurrencyCode`. Currency identified by its ISO currency code. _(requirements: REQ-022-2, REQ-086)_
- **hub_currency_rate** — business key `currency_rate`. Daily exchange rate converting one currency to another on a given date. _(requirements: REQ-024-2, REQ-025-2, REQ-062-2, REQ-013-3)_
- **hub_special_offer** — business key `SpecialOfferID`. Special offer / promotional discount. _(requirements: REQ-008-2, REQ-051, REQ-085)_
- **hub_sales_reason** — business key `SalesReasonID`. Sales reason from the sales reason catalogue. _(requirements: REQ-055)_
- **hub_shopping_cart_item** — business key `shopping_cart_item`. Online shopping cart item, identified within its shopping cart. _(requirements: REQ-001-2, REQ-002-2, REQ-087)_
- **hub_sales_tax_rate** — business key `SalesTaxRateID`. Sales tax rate from the tax rate register. _(requirements: REQ-035-2, REQ-084)_

### Links (20)

- **link_customer_business_entity** — connects hub_customer, hub_business_entity (person), hub_business_entity (store). Customer kind: the person who is an individual customer or the store that is a store customer. Unit of work: Customer AccountNumber with its PersonID / StoreID references. _(requirements: REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-008, REQ-055-2, REQ-083)_
- **link_customer_sales_territory** — connects hub_customer, hub_sales_territory. Sales territory in which a customer is located. _(requirements: REQ-006, REQ-054-2, REQ-010)_
- **link_business_entity_store_sales_person** — connects hub_business_entity, hub_business_entity (sales_person). Sales representative assigned to a reseller store. _(requirements: REQ-013, REQ-056-2, REQ-030-3)_
- **link_business_entity_sales_territory** — connects hub_business_entity, hub_sales_territory. Territory a sales representative is currently assigned to (current value on the representative record). _(requirements: REQ-061, REQ-057-2, REQ-011-3)_
- **link_business_entity_sales_territory_history** — connects hub_business_entity, hub_sales_territory. Dated history of which representative worked which territory. Driving key: hub_business_entity. _(requirements: REQ-006-3, REQ-007-3, REQ-008-3, REQ-009-3, REQ-010-3, REQ-058-2)_
